# Support

## Product & Documentation

- **Web Application:** <https://optikformokuyucu.com>
- **Publisher Website:** <https://vellium.dev>
- **In-App Documentation:** Open the **Documentation (`/rehber`)** view inside Optical Form Reader (or press `F1`).

## Bugs and feature requests

- Search existing issues first.
- Open a bug report or feature request through the issue templates.
- Include the Optical Form Reader version (`v1.0.0`), Windows build or browser version, installation type, and reproduction steps.
- You can write in Turkish or English.

## Security issues

Do not open a public issue. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) and email <security@vellium.dev>.

## Corporate & Customer Support

For support, licensing, or institutional deployment questions, contact <support@vellium.dev> (general inquiries: <contact@vellium.dev>, legal: <legal@vellium.dev>, privacy/KVKK: <privacy@vellium.dev>) or visit <https://vellium.dev>.
